blocks.title: Calm, gesture-first, content before chrome.
blocks.lead: Etesian is a way of designing as much as a piece of software. It starts from what the Nokia N9 got right and carries it to today’s screens.

items.title: Content before chrome
items.text: Screens show what matters; controls step back. One row of chrome, never two.

items.title: Gestures, not buttons
items.text: The edges of the screen minimise and close, everywhere, the same way. Nothing in an app imitates them.

items.title: Calm by default
items.text: Nothing shouts for attention. Everything that happened waits in one place: Events.

items.title: Faithful first
items.text: The N9 behaviour is the default. Every addition is optional and starts switched off.

items.title: The squircle
items.text: Every thumb-sized shape, from app icons to avatars, is a superellipse measured from the N9’s own icons. Never a circle, never a rounded square.

items.title: Lit from the top
items.text: Icons and buttons are lit objects: a soft gradient, a thin rim, a gentle sheen.

items.title: Light, large type
items.text: Big, thin headings and plain text. Type follows the system’s size and weight settings.

items.title: Colour that means something
items.text: Each app has its own colour, used on its main header and icon. Sub pages stay plain.

items.title: Black home, light pages
items.text: The home views are black; apps are light. Dark and light modes keep the same structure.

items.title: Motion with purpose
items.text: Apps slide in, slide away when minimised and follow the finger when closed. No splash screens.

blocks.heading: Heritage
paragraphs: The design language is built from careful study of the N9 (2011): its gestures, proportions and behaviour. Where the N9 had no answer, for larger screens, a pointer or a keyboard, the gaps are filled in the same spirit. Fonts, icons and sounds are open or made for the project.
